sentences.zh: 經理人必須謹慎地將團隊的時間分配到多個專案之中。

words.defn_en: comparable, similar:

sentences.zh: 人類心臟的運作方式與機械幫浦有相似之處。

sentences.en: Her situation is ______ to that of many other single parents.
sentences.zh: 她的處境與許多其他單親家長的情況類似。

words.defn_en: a comparison between two things to explain or clarify:

sentences.zh: 老師用一個簡單的比喻,把心臟比作幫浦,來解釋血液循環。

sentences.en: Her ______ between the internet and a highway system helped the students understand data flow.
sentences.zh: 她把網際網路比喻成高速公路系統的類比,幫助學生理解資料的流動。

words.defn_en: science of the origins and social relationships of humans:

sentences.en: She majored in ______ to study how ancient cultures shaped modern society.
sentences.zh: 她主修人類學,以研究古代文化如何塑造現代社會。

sentences.en: The ______ professor spent years living among remote tribes.
sentences.zh: 這位人類學教授花了好幾年時間與偏遠部落一起生活。

words.defn_en: the study claiming that the positions of stars influence human affairs:

sentences.zh: 她每天都會看星座運勢,不過她把占星學當作娛樂看待。

sentences.en: Skeptics dismiss ______ as lacking any scientific basis.
sentences.zh: 懷疑論者認為占星學缺乏任何科學根據,因而不予採信。

words.defn_en: a scientist who studies living organisms:

sentences.zh: 這位海洋生物學家為她的研究而研究珊瑚礁生態系統。

sentences.en: He decided to become a ______ after taking a fascinating high school course.
sentences.zh: 他在修完一門引人入勝的高中課程後決定成為一位生物學家。

words.defn_en: the science that studies living organisms:

sentences.en: She has wanted to study ______ ever since she got her first microscope.
sentences.zh: 自從得到第一台顯微鏡以來,她就一直想研讀生物學。

sentences.en: The ______ teacher brought in real frogs for the dissection lab.
sentences.zh: 這位生物老師帶來了真的青蛙供解剖實驗課使用。

words.defn_en: speaking in a brief, concise manner:

sentences.zh: 這位將軍以言簡意賅著稱,下達命令總是用最少的字。

sentences.en: Her ______ reports impressed executives who had little patience for long meetings.
sentences.zh: 她言簡意賅的報告,讓沒耐心聽冗長會議的主管們印象深刻。

words.defn_en: poor choice of words or bad style in speech or writing:

sentences.en: The editor's notes pointed out several instances of ______ in the first draft.
sentences.zh: 編輯的批註指出了初稿中好幾處措辭不當的地方。

sentences.en: His speeches, full of ______ , rarely persuaded anyone.
sentences.zh: 他的演講充斥著拙劣的措辭,幾乎說服不了任何人。

words.defn_en: a doctor specializing in disorders of the heart:

sentences.en: The ______ scheduled a stress test to check his heart function.
sentences.zh: 這位心臟科醫師安排了一項壓力測試,以檢查他的心臟功能。

sentences.en: She was referred to a ______ after her EKG showed irregularities.
sentences.zh: 她的心電圖顯示異常後被轉診給一位心臟科醫師。

words.defn_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the heart and its diseases:

sentences.en: She decided to specialize in ______ after her grandfather's heart surgery.
sentences.zh: 在祖父接受心臟手術後,她決定專攻心臟病學。

sentences.en: The hospital's ______ department is one of the best in the country.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院的心臟科在全國名列前茅。

words.defn_en: arranged in order of time:

sentences.zh: 這場博物館展覽按時間順序呈現這位藝術家的作品。

sentences.en: Please list your work experience in ______ order, starting with the most recent.
sentences.zh: 請按時間順序列出你的工作經歷,從最近的開始。

words.defn_en: speaking in circles; roundabout speech

sentences.en: He used so much ______ that no one understood his actual point.
sentences.zh: 他用了太多迂迴的說法,結果沒人聽懂他真正的重點。

sentences.en: Instead of a direct answer, she offered only vague ______.
sentences.zh: 她沒有直接回答,只提供了一堆含糊迂迴的說詞。

words.defn_en: using an indirect and wordy way of speaking, avoiding directness:

sentences.en: His ______ answer left the reporters more confused than before they asked.
sentences.zh: 他拐彎抹角的回答,讓記者比提問前更加困惑。

sentences.en: The contract's ______ language made it nearly impossible to understand the actual terms.
sentences.zh: 這份合約迂迴的措辭,讓人幾乎無法理解實際的條款內容。

words.defn_en: pertaining to common everyday speech; conversational

sentences.en: The novel's ______ dialogue made the characters feel real.
sentences.zh: 這部小說口語化的對話讓角色顯得真實生動。

sentences.en: "Gonna" is a ______ contraction of "going to."
sentences.zh: 「gonna」是「going to」的口語化縮寫。

words.defn_en: a doctor specializing in skin disorders:

sentences.zh: 他就手臂上持續不退的疹子諮詢了一位皮膚科醫師。

sentences.en: The ______ recommended a stronger sunscreen for daily use.
sentences.zh: 這位皮膚科醫師建議每天使用防曬係數更高的產品。

words.defn_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the skin:

sentences.zh: 她預約了皮膚科,以便檢查這顆痣。

sentences.zh: 皮膚科學的進步讓治療嚴重痤瘡變得容易許多。

words.defn_en: a conversation between two persons:

sentences.zh: 這兩位領袖同意展開對話,以解決這場衝突。

sentences.en: The film's ______ felt natural and unscripted.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的對白感覺自然而未經刻意安排。

words.defn_en: speaking in a learned or scholarly manner:

sentences.en: The ______ scholar impressed the entire committee.
sentences.zh: 這位博學善辯的學者讓整個委員會印象深刻。

sentences.en: His ______ style sometimes confused less educated listeners.
sentences.zh: 他博學善辯的說話風格有時會讓教育程度較低的聽眾感到困惑。

words.defn_en: a short hymn of praise to God:

sentences.en: The congregation sang the ______ at the close of the service.
sentences.zh: 會眾在禮拜結束時唱了頌榮詩。

sentences.zh: 一首傳統的頌榮詩數個世紀以來一直是禮拜儀式的一部分。

words.defn_en: artful ease with speaking that impacts people's feelings

sentences.en: Her ______ moved the entire audience to tears.
sentences.zh: 她的口才動人,讓全場觀眾為之落淚。

sentences.zh: 這位律師的雄辯口才有助於讓陪審團倒向他的當事人。

words.defn_en: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing:

sentences.zh: 這位講者雄辯滔滔的話語激勵了在場的觀眾。

sentences.en: His speech was not only ______ but also extremely compelling.
sentences.zh: 他的演講不僅口才流利,而且極具說服力。

words.defn_en: a scientist who studies insects:

sentences.zh: 這本教科書的章節涵蓋了傳染病的病因學。

sentences.zh: 這位詞源學家追溯這個字的源頭至古代梵文。

sentences.en: An ______ explained how slang words enter the dictionary.
sentences.zh: 一位詞源學家解釋了俚語如何被收入詞典。

words.defn_en: the history of words, their origin and development:

sentences.zh: 了解一個字的詞源有助於學生記住它的意思。

sentences.zh: 這篇訃聞頌揚了她數十年來對社區的服務貢獻。

sentences.zh: 這篇悼詞回顧了他一生對公共服務的奉獻。

sentences.zh: 她投身老年學領域的職涯,以協助改善老年照護。

sentences.en: Researchers in ______ study how the body changes with age.
sentences.zh: 老年學的研究人員探討身體如何隨年齡增長而變化。
